crossSourceFindings: Working references are strategy packs plus capture envelopes, not isolated Discord-domain lists.
The common TCP surface includes 80/443 and often 2053/2083/2087/2096/8443; game-filter variants can widen to 1024-65535.
The common UDP surface includes 443 and often Discord/STUN/game ranges; v0.4 should keep UDP/voice as a separate later lane.
Packet windows are usually wider than Zap2's initial early-flow diagnostic: upstream zapret2 examples use 20 outgoing TCP packets and 10 incoming TCP packets.
Discord is frequently handled through a general Cloudflare/Discord bucket rather than only updates.discord.com.
Windows references must be treated as questions about capture-envelope translation, not as Linux recipes.
